runs.name: Run #2
runs.notes:
Run #2 on Switch 2. Official clock includes roughly ten minutes idle at a bench before the 3:34 split.

Forum was 3 attempts with G&Z, Dice, Cogfly, Straight Pin, Mirror, and Injector Band. Scout took about 8 attempts.

After the 4:20 checkpoint, collected Greymoor spool 478263 with the Craw Lake arena uncleared and acquired Weighted Belt. Lace 2 fell at 4:57. Patient punishes and Silk saved for healing worked. Belt made a noticeable difference. Injector Band, Claw Mirror, Belt, and Dice were equipped. Some Straight Pin openings were found. Cogfly wasn't used for the Lace clear. The interval includes detours, so it isn't a measure of boss time alone.

Grand Mother Silk and the final time are pending. The user intends to play through for practice.
